<?php
class AssetsController
{
    public function actionIcon(string $extension): Response
    {
        $path = Assets::iconPath($extension);
        return $this->response->sendFile($path, "$extension.svg", ['inline' => true]);
    }
}

class Assets
{
    public static function iconPath(string $extension): string
    {
        $path = sprintf('%s%s%s.svg', '/var/www/icons', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, strtolower($extension));
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            return $path;
        }
        FileHelper::writeToFile($path, '<svg></svg>');
        return $path;
    }
}

notes.probe:
<?php
$ticket = $_GET['ticket'];

class FileSystemTicketStore
{
    private string $pathToTicketDirectory = '/var/lib/tickets';

    public function getTicket(string $ticketId): ?array
    {
        $filename = $this->pathToTicketDirectory . '/' . $ticketId;
        if (file_exists($filename)) {
            return unserialize(file_get_contents($filename));
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function deleteTicket(string $ticketId): void
    {
        $filename = $this->pathToTicketDirectory . '/' . $ticketId;
        if (file_exists($filename)) {
            unlink($filename);
        }
    }
}

<?php
$file = $request->file('name');

class FileUploader
{
    public function handle(UploadedFile $file, string $path = 'files')
    {
        $extension = strtolower($file->getClientOriginalExtension());
        $filename = Str::slug($file->getClientOriginalName()) . '.' . $extension;

        $stored = $file->storeAs($path, $filename, 'public');

        return ['path' => $stored];
    }
}
